descriptor.scope: 15 valid distinct public cadastral-reference polygons verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP settlement locator. Complete bounded manifest paging, forced three-row pages, all 15 fresh source-ID reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 58 requests. Independent metric EPSG:32643 GEOS found all geometries valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Public source-native OBJECTID is the cadastral-reference geometry identity, not a legal Khasra/Mouza key. Returned legal key fields are zero and are not promoted to legal identifiers. The real runtime adapter uses the documented anonymous public-viewer reader bootstrap; reader tokens stay in memory, simultaneous reads share one bootstrap, and renewal occurs within thirty seconds because publisher expiry omits a timezone. All request evidence omits token values. Six headless reader tests verify renewal, coalescing, endpoint confinement, unchanged geometry, blocked responses and safe errors. Native source CRS is EPSG:3857 (ArcGIS WKID102100). The original exact-point sample is topologically identical to fresh complete geometry: ring coordinate order differs, while projected symmetric difference and Hausdorff distance are both zero. Citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy, currentness and long-term GIS key continuity remain unverified.
